predict.question: B starts with eight reserve hours, gains two and consumes three per round for four rounds. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: An Elegant Puzzle discusses engineering organizations through capacity, constraints and deliberate choices about operating them.
modelBoundary: A ends with {A} reserve hours; B with {B}. Interruptions consume one more hour than is replenished each round, exhausting the smaller reserve. Reserve replenishment and interruption demand are invented; this is not a staffing or burnout model.
